# Fixtures

`application_settings_*.json` are application-settings documents.

## `pre_p4_*`: written before the P4 sidecar moves

These were generated by the Mere code at 31bf7ab3b, unmodified (the parent
tree of the commit that added them, "Pandect: fixtures written by the code
before the P4 sidecar moves"), so they predate every change in the sidecar
move. Nothing else in the tree changed when they were made. The generator was a
temporary `#[ignore]` test inside `graph_session.rs` (it needed the private
`MereSessions::create`), run once with `--features personal-sync` and removed
before the commit. The calls below are the ones it made. Ids are `Uuid::from_u128`
of the number shown.

- `pre_p4_container_facets_store/`: a `muniment::DirectoryBackend` store.
  - Graph: `kernel::graph::replay_captured_deltas` of `ReplayAddNodeWithIdIfMissing`
    for nodes 1, 2, 3 (url `https://<n>.test/`) and
    `ReplayAssertRelationByIds` 1 -> 2 (`SemanticSubKind::Cites`).
  - Container id 0xC0. Facets on it, written into a `NodeFacetStore` and installed
    with `Graph::install_facets`:
    - `write_scene_facets` with size_by_degree true, size_by_importance false,
      importance_metric "betweenness", physics_damping 6.25;
    - `write_arrangement_regions` with one region, contour (0,0), (10,0), (10,10),
      label "outside", members 3 and 99;
    - `write_arrangement_mosaic` with group_of (3, "g"), group_order ["g"],
      member_order 3, 99, 1, scale (3, 1.5).
  - Session: `GraphSessionManifest::new(SessionId 0x5E55, GraphId 0xC0)`,
    display name "Donor", created with
    `MereSessions::create(manifest, Some(&graph), Author::person("persona-a").via("turnstone"), ChangeKind::Minted)`.
    The `.muniment-lock` file was removed.
- `pre_p4_sync_record_with_scene.cbor`: `p2panda_core::cbor::encode_cbor` of a
  `PersonalGraphRecord` with events `AddTag { node 1, tag "t" }` and
  `SaveScene { node 2, scene }`, parents `[[7; 32]]`, no writer attestation.
  The scene is a `SavedSceneV2` named "Shared scene" (selected 1, 2; layout
  "grid.default"; physics paused, damping 0.7, law "spring.rapier", overlays
  ["hubs"]; sources site/site/degree/roots; arrangement_pull 0.4; roles default
  "seeded", group example.com -> "anchored", item 1 -> "pinned"; dynamics
  `{"version": 9, "future": {"k": [1, 2.5, "x"]}}`; camera (12, 24) zoom 1.2;
  handler "graphshell.inspect"; cartography positions 1 -> (1.5, -2.25)).
- `pre_p4_product_codicil_with_scene.json`: `serde_json::to_vec_pretty` of a
  `ProductCodicilV3` (schema `PRODUCT_CODICIL_SCHEMA`, scope `SavedScene`,
  exported_at_ms 1700000000000, the snapshot of nodes 1, 2 related 1 -> 2, empty
  facets) with a `SavedSceneV3` named "Codicil scene" (selected 1; dynamics
  `{"version": 9, "x": [0.1, 2]}`; camera (3, 4) zoom 0.5; handler
  "graphshell.inspect"; cartography positions 1 -> (1.5, -2.25)).

`.gitattributes` marks `pre_p4_**` as `-text` so the bytes stay as written.
